sources.snippet: nunchaku_lite currently supports Diffusers pipelines whose transformer or UNet component matches one of the built-in adapters below. Checkpoints should be SVDQ W4A4 Nunchaku v2 .safetensors files in INT4 or FP4 format. Full runnable model guides live under docs/models/.
